thread:
liam: FYI getting a bunch of 502/504s from hosted inference endpoints since ~09:12 UTC, customers complaining about timeouts.
sophia: saw that — dashboard shows spike in kv-prefix errors and connection churn to memcached cluster in us-west-2. logs: \"kv-proxy: tls handshake error: EOF\" and \"kv-client: auth rejected token\".
arjun: oncall — can you confirm if any auth rotations or certs rolled recently? I don't see a planned rotation.
melissa: no manual rotations. telemetry shows connection_pool_waits spiking and fd_count approaching limits on kv-proxy-07..09.
infra-bot: alert: kv-prefix-pool-saturation (us-west-2) >95% for 14m. incident_id=INC-2026-307
liam: reproduction quick test —\n```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $PROD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}' -v
```
\nResponse: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{\"error\":\"upstream timeout (kv prefix lookup)\"}
sophia: repro matches. stack trace from kv-proxy: \n\"connect tcp 10.2.5.12:11211: i/o timeout\" and auth failures right before.
arjun: possible root causes: memcached auth credentials expired/rotated; or client-side TLS handshake regression after cert update.
melissa: checking vault — memcached service token last rotated 2026-03-17T08:00Z but rotation job succeeded. however transport cert on kv-proxy hosts shows new cert with SAN mismatch for cluster. suspect mismatch causing handshake fails.
liam: mitigation options: 1) route traffic to memcached-fallback cluster, 2) throttle prefetch/prefix lookups at API gateway to reduce concurrent connections, 3) quick fix: disable TLS on kv-proxy->memcached temporarily in us-west (only if enterprise ok).
support-ops: priority: customers on hosted tier seeing 10-20% error rates. Need rollback that avoids data exposure.
sophia: started rollout: 1) increase conn_pool_max from 200 -> 500 on kv-proxy ASG; 2) disable aggressive prefix prefetching flag (prefetch.enabled=false) for hosted API; 3) add short-circuit: if kv latency > 250ms return cached fallback rather than block.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: config kv-proxy/max_conns=500 -> applied to kv-proxy-05..09. rollout 3/5 hosts done.
melissa: after first hosts flipped, connection_waits down 40%, memcached auth failures drop. will continue.
liam: customer update drafted: \"We identified connection/auth handshake issues between our cache proxy and a memcached cluster in us-west-2. We applied configuration changes and traffic routing to reduce errors. We're monitoring, please share any ongoing errors.\" @support-ops please send.
support-ops: sent to affected tenants at 09:41 UTC.
sophia: metrics now: 502s down to baseline within 18m after full rollout. prefetched lookups dropped 70% — tail latency improved.
arjun: create follow-up: rotate certs back with correct SAN, add e2e test for kv-proxy->memcached TLS handshake on deploy, and add circuit-breaker threshold to avoid long blocking during cache dependency outages.
melissa: opened ticket: RED-INC-2026-307-postmortem, linking logs and timeline. tentative blameless summary: cert mismatch + pool exhaustion amplified prefetch load -> 5xx/timeouts.
liam: thanks team. can we also add a temporary runbook entry: if kv-prefix pool saturation >80% trigger auto-scale instance count + disable prefetch flag automatically? would help next time.
sophia: agreed — adding runbook item now.
liam: closing thread when postmortem is up. great work everyone :thumbsup:
